title: Moving-multiplier complement-ratio averaging
objective: Attempt and independently check a genuinely quantitative complement-ratio averaging bound uniform in a moving coprime multiplier, while preserving the remaining Goldbach prime-correlation and prime-list obligations.
deliverables: Uniform fixed-u and summed estimates with all factors
success_criteria: The new estimate is proved rather than assumed
H and k dependence and coprimality remain explicit
Complement-ratio averaging is not promoted to prime-list or prime-correlation cancellation
The original Goldbach objective remains active unless actually achieved
stop_conditions: One bounded theorem-fleet round within20 proxy units
No external mutable action or provider billing
Preserve failures rather than weaken the requested Goldbach objective
